title: TransformGeometryNode scales handle offset vectors
description: When scaling, vertex positions scale but bezier handle offset vectors do not, so curves distort. Fix: apply the linear part of the transform (scale + rotation) to handle vectors in both _bezier_handles_start and _bezier_handles_end. Translation does nothing to offsets (correct as-is).
definition-of-done: 1. Handle vectors transformed correctly under scale. 2. Handle vectors transformed correctly under rotation. 3. Translation unaffected. 4. Fallback when no handles.
testing-plan: 1. cube->assign_bezier_handles->transform_geometry(scale=2,2,2)->coons_patch produces scaled smooth mesh with same curve shape as unscaled version.
